# failure_label

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Classifies a preserved failure by causal scope so failed challengers remain usable learning evidence.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `failure_id` | `string` | yes | Stable failure evidence identity. |
| `episode_id` | `string` | yes | Episode in which the failure occurred. |
| `failure_class` | `string` | yes | Typed subject, environment, policy, or authority failure class. |
| `causal_scope` | `string` | yes | Smallest supported causal boundary. |
| `preserved_evidence_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest proving the failed evidence was retained. |
